The `sha256sums` array contains a valid checksum, so no SKIP or missing verification issues arise even though they would not affect this command. There are no command substitutions, `curl`/`wget` calls, `eval`, or any other dynamic code execution at the top level. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for `--printsrcinfo` poses no risk of remote code execution, data exfiltration, or unintended side effects.
